act_title: The Representation of the People Act, 1951
title: Decision of the High Court
text:
98. Decision of the High Court.—At the conclusion of the trial of an election petition

1[the High Court] shall make an order—

(a) dismissing the election petition; or

(b) declaring the election of [all or any of the returned candidates] to be void; or

(c) declaring the election of [all or any of the returned candidates] to be void and the petitioner or

any other candidate to have been duly elected.
